hedging_notes: Makes precision parts for US semiconductor-equipment makers: about USD 8m of customer receipts a month, costs mostly in SGD. Board policy: hedge 50-75% of forecast USD receipts, layered monthly with 3M and 6M USD/SGD forwards; a forward is rolled with an FX swap when a customer pays late. Also buying a new machining line from a Japanese supplier, paid in four JPY instalments of about JPY 750m; each instalment is hedged with a USD/JPY forward once its invoice is confirmed.
